column1: # Forever Blacksmithing: how a character learns the new recipes of blacksmithing.tsv that the Forever trainers teach
# (jvbastel/WOWAI#239, spec #225). forever/generator makes the trainer rows (forever_npc_trainer) and the skill line
# ability of each row from it. Never edit a generated file by hand. To gather the data again, see forever/REFRESH.md.
# Source: the Forever beta Blacksmithing data of wowtbc.gg and the warcraft.wiki.gg page "Forever blacksmithing
# plans", read 2026-10-31 (notes/forever/bs-trainers-research-2026-10-31.md): both mark these 9 recipes as trainer
# recipes. The skill is the recipe's minRank in blacksmithing.tsv. No Forever source gives which trainer teaches a
#   kind          trainer (the trainers teach the recipe) or auto (a character learns it with the profession skill,
#                 with no trainer step, as stock Rough Copper Vest 12260: the AcquireMethod of its skill line ability)
#   recipe        the new recipe spell of blacksmithing.tsv
#   learnSpell    the spell that the trainer casts: the learn spell of the recipe's plans (a copy of stock 2760,
#   trainersFrom  the stock recipe whose stock trainer rows (npc_trainer) the recipe takes: every trainer that
#                 teaches it teaches the new recipe. Pick a stock recipe that the stock trainers teach at about the
#                 recipe's skill, not below it (a trainer whose rank caps below the skill must not teach it). - for auto
#   cost          the trainer cost in copper: a guess, the stock cost of trainersFrom (npc_trainer.spellcost).
# --- #239 the trainer recipes of the Forever beta that no trainer taught. The plans stay as they are.
